items.title: Updated to Python 3.9.1 (64bit) from 3.8 32 bit. Now I can't get MySQL code to work
items.body:
I hope this is what I am supposed to do..... Below is the history

Microsoft Windows [Version 10.0.19042.685]

C:\Users\JK>pip list
Package         Version
--------------- -------
click           7.1.2
Flask           1.1.2
Flask-MySQL     1.5.1
itsdangerous    1.1.0
Jinja2          2.11.2
MarkupSafe      1.1.1
mysql           0.0.2
mysql-connector 2.2.9
mysqlclient     2.0.2
pip             20.3.3
PyMySQL         0.10.1
setuptools      49.2.1
Werkzeug        1.0.1

C:\Users\JK>python 
3.9.1 64 bit (AMD64)] on win32

I tried various suggestions (of what to install) with pip in this thread to no avail. ImportError: No module named 'MySQL'

The PyCharm error: (<class 'ModuleNotFoundError'>, ModuleNotFoundError("No module named 'mysql'")

I tried the original python code to access mysql first I had working under 3.8 32 bit.

snipit-1:

    import mysql.connector <---- gave me a similar error
    mydb = mysql.connector.connect(
    host="localhost",
    user="root",
    password="****",
    database='db_name'
    )
    mycursor = mydb.cursor()

snipit-2 <---- this comes from a tutorial I found last night from 2019.

    from flask import MySQL <----- this gave the error
    mysql = MySQL()
    app.config['MYSQL_DATABASE_USER'] = 'root'
    app.config['MYSQL_DATABASE_PASSWORD'] = '*****'
    app.config['MYSQL_DATABASE_DB'] = 'db_name'
    app.config['MYSQL_DATABASE_HOST'] = 'localhost'
    mysql.init_app(app)
    mysql_connection =  mysql.connect()
    mycursor = mysql_connection.cursor()
